# corral + netstead documentation

Generated from the mkdocs nav for AI-agent consumption. Each link below points at the canonical rendered page.

## corral docs

- [Home](https://e-lo.github.io/netstead/corral/index.md): corral overview + install.
- [Quickstart](https://e-lo.github.io/netstead/corral/quickstart.md): Install, load any Frictionless package, validate it in 5 minutes.

## Concepts

- [Frictionless data packages](https://e-lo.github.io/netstead/corral/concepts/frictionless.md): The spec both packages build on.
- [When to use ibis vs pandas vs polars](https://e-lo.github.io/netstead/corral/concepts/engines.md): The compute engine (DuckDB) and pandas/polars/Arrow dataframe formats.

## AI surface
